description: Header file for injector_central module, providing utility functions related to fuel injection system testing and initialization.

methods.name: fanBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test of the fan.

methods.name: fuelPumpBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test of the fuel pump.

methods.name: milBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test related to the malfunction indicator light.

methods.name: initInjectorCentral
methods.description: Initializes the injector central subsystem with a shared logger.

methods.name: isRunningBenchTest
methods.description: Checks if a bench test is currently running.

methods.name: runBenchTest
methods.description: Runs a specific bench test given subsystem and index identifiers.
